selection: all frozen train queries sorted by query_id
long_suffix: modern durable compact versatile easy assembly for everyday home use
category_mix: cycle queries from most frequent train query_class; ties lexicographic; retain population size
short_generic: first whitespace-delimited token; retain original class as source annotation, not inferred new intent

feature_definitions.characters: Python Unicode codepoint count, no normalization
feature_definitions.tokens: Python str.split whitespace token count; not model subword tokens
feature_definitions.classes: frozen source query_class; synthetic text transformations do not relabel intent
feature_definitions.scalar_drift: 1-Wasserstein in original units, no fitted bins
feature_definitions.embedding: existing normalized encoder, mean L2 norm and centroid cosine distance
feature_definitions.reranker: top1 logits, top1 minus top2 margin, all returned CE20 score distribution; not calibrated probabilities
feature_definitions.rank_displacement: mean absolute rank change among shared Top10 IDs, per query then macro mean; missing IDs reported by overlap

scope: synthetic offline replay only; quality evaluated only for unmodified train queries; no model selection
